queuePolicy.autoAdvanceOnlyWhen: all prerequisites and a deterministic acceptance predicate are satisfied
queuePolicy.modelPolicy: deterministic checks use no model; architecture uses Fable 5.1 only when critical; independent review uses gpt-6-astra/high

items.title: Detect provider-accepted turns that never start
items.acceptance: A provider_turn_start_timeout moves the child to ORCH_BLOCKED, persists a typed receipt, wakes the manager once, and performs no model poll or automatic retry beyond policy.

items.title: Detect active children with no provider item or artifact progress
items.acceptance: An active child with durable STARTED state, no active provider item, and no event/artifact progress past its deadline becomes a single manager exception without unbounded polling.

items.title: Preflight provider and model bridge availability before dispatch
evidenceRefs: thr_yqpdshj4nt provisioning failure: Provider claude has no bridge to run on
items.acceptance: Before creating a worker, the supervisor verifies that the requested provider, model, and execution bridge are callable; unavailable capability yields one durable typed CAPABILITY_BLOCKED result with zero worker/model work, and a fallback occurs only when the task policy names an exact allowed fallback and records the lineage.

items.title: Bind active tasks to immutable campaign input revisions
items.acceptance: At task admission, the manager persists an immutable content-addressed input snapshot and stable task identity. Final verification rehashes that snapshot, never a mutable campaign-head path. A newer queue revision is reconciled afterward as applied, still-applicable, or superseded without repinning, rerunning, or crediting stale results; a one-property snapshot mutation fails closed.

items.title: Integrate stable task IDs, durable STARTED receipts, and bounded deterministic reassignment
items.acceptance: A task persists pending->started->terminal attempt lineage, reassigns at most the declared bound with the same idempotency key, credits no unpersisted reasoning, and preserves the aggregate ORCH_BLOCKED diagnostic at exhaustion.

items.title: Join reviewed manager/supervisor V8 with the installed f633578 fleet
items.acceptance: A fresh integration worktree joins local reviewed commit f3ea828 with installed f633578, preserves U1/U2 and envelope-v4 behavior, passes focused/full tests and independent Astra review, and is promoted by exact commit/tree/subtree.

items.title: Preserve exact version-1 OFF behavior
items.acceptance: Version-1 replay produces byte-identical receipts, outputs, and error precedence to the pinned base; every new classification and recovery branch is gated to version 2.

items.title: Make wake delivery recoverable without duplicate sends
items.acceptance: Persist attempted/unknown before wake; restart performs readbackWake before resend; found, absent, and indeterminate are explicit and bounded; one stable key produces at most one accepted wake.

items.title: Recover an owned launch claim after a pre-effect crash
items.acceptance: A confirmed-absent owned launch resumes once with the same operation identity; ambiguous or found readback never duplicates the launch; exhaustion remains visibly blocked.

items.title: Persist and validate exact U2 result bytes on every path
items.acceptance: Every production and injected U2 result is schema-validated, retained byte-for-byte, independently rehashable, and bound to resultSha256; malformed or throwing results fail closed with zero preservation and launches.

items.title: Admit a valid second drift observation after prior supersession
items.acceptance: A second event is accepted only when exact receipt identity, artifact hashes, applied-history entry, and invalidating-decision preimage prove admission before supersession; U2 receives a deterministic applied-only historical view and returns COMPONENT_REDESIGN.

items.title: Remove unreachable amendment-successor semantics from U3
items.acceptance: U3 contains no transition or test requiring AUTHORIZED_AMENDMENT, RELAUNCH_SUCCESSOR, or T12; PROPOSED_AMENDMENT remains evidence metadata and any legitimate objective successor uses the separately governed manager revision path.

items.title: Replace snapshot-trusting journal recovery with a closed total aggregate
items.acceptance: The design uses immutable raw capture plus closed per-record aggregates and source-checked atomic transitions; every declared state is reachable, every nonterminal has forward/recovery handling, unspecified pairs fail closed, and no terminal revives.

items.title: Prevent duplicate capture claimants from parsing
items.acceptance: The atomic claim winner alone parses; losers read and verify the winner or report a collision; restart recovery remains possible without concurrent double processing.

items.title: Route every version-2 finalizer through receipt-first capture
items.acceptance: Typed, prework, generic, result, and drift finalizers either durably capture raw bytes with an out-of-band stable key before parse or are rejected before launch; legacy routes remain byte-identical.

items.title: Preserve running supersession and cancellation intent
items.acceptance: Every actually launched unresolved attempt remains superseded_running with cancellationRequested and immutable attempt identity; late receipts cannot revive it and completed work stays correctly classified.

items.title: Expose and test deterministic directory-order injection
items.acceptance: An authority-owned readdir permutation seam executes four distinct orderings and preserves decision, operation, and action identities without relying on source-local assertions.

items.title: Bound and sanitize publisher-controlled text
items.acceptance: terminalState and threadId use closed short patterns; exception and rejection detail has a fixed byte budget; injected payload text cannot enlarge or enter the manager brief.

items.title: Reject duplicate campaign IDs under one manager
items.acceptance: Registry/watchdog loading rejects duplicate managerThreadId+campaignId pairs and reports an error rather than Set-collapsing them.

items.title: Make reconciliation lock ownership atomic
items.acceptance: A crash cannot leave an ownerless permanent lock; acquisition atomically publishes ownership or a bounded stale-owner rule recovers it with deterministic diagnostics.

items.title: Persist launch binding immediately after spawn
items.acceptance: The worker binding is atomically persisted immediately after spawn and before later reconciliation work, reducing dependence on title adoption after a crash.

items.title: Keep raw payloads out of the manager path
items.acceptance: Wake text points only to manager-brief; manager-facing CLI/dashboard surfaces omit raw receipt payloads; a marker falsifier proves no payload enters manager context.

items.title: Make dry-run semantics truthful and non-mutating
items.acceptance: A non-apply reconcile either performs no persisted transition or the CLI explicitly stops calling it side-effect-free; tests bind the chosen contract.

items.title: Retire predecessor campaigns when a successor is initialized
items.acceptance: A manager-authorized successor makes the predecessor unsendable through an immutable supersededBy join or registry enforcement; both revisions cannot launch concurrently.

items.title: Detect a worker thread bound across campaigns
items.acceptance: The watchdog reports duplicate worker threadId bindings across a manager's campaigns as an error before accepting results or launching successors.

items.title: Correct the legacy compatibility claim
items.acceptance: Documentation names the exact preserved behaviors and the deliberate pre-binding, receipt-precedence, wake-text, and additive-field deltas; known external wake consumers are enumerated.

items.title: Bound watchdog run-receipt growth
items.acceptance: Watchdog receipts follow a deterministic count/age retention policy and a long-run test proves disk growth is bounded.

items.title: Document or strengthen the cooperative-thread threat model
items.acceptance: The docs state that actor and thread identity are consistency-checked, not cryptographically authenticated, and explicitly bound the supported same-user BB threat model.

items.title: Use locale-independent code-point ordering
items.acceptance: All final deterministic tiebreaks use explicit code-point comparison and pass under multiple locale settings.

items.title: Bound wake-marker history reads
items.acceptance: Wake dedupe uses a bounded cursor/tail or durable local marker; cost does not grow with the full manager transcript and no delivery is lost.

items.title: Eliminate personal-workspace environment registration races
items.acceptance: A workflow resolves/reuses the personal workspace before spawn, concurrent registrations converge idempotently, and a 409 becomes a deterministic adoption/retry decision without cancelling the campaign.

items.title: Generate consumer CLI invocations from the installed parser
items.acceptance: A data-only adapter generator emits parser-valid argv, exact executable, exact output roots, and absence predicates; missing/extra/unsupported flag controls fail before freeze or model calls.

items.title: Preflight exact runtime and dependency resolution
evidenceRefs: R1 and R2 exact-base worktrees missing ajv
items.acceptance: Before one-shot work, the gate resolves and pins Node and all review dependencies, proves the exact command in the target environment, and returns one typed capability blocker with zero candidate calls.

items.title: Type and canonically digest installed dependency receipts
items.acceptance: Dependency preflight emits a schema-versioned receipt naming the object kind, root, canonical enumeration algorithm, toolchain, lockfile digest, installed-tree digest, and required-module resolution; consumers cannot compare digests of different object kinds and no source/static work begins on mismatch.

items.title: Gate transient native-watch capacity before watcher-dependent validation
items.acceptance: Under serialized heavy ownership, a preflight creates exactly one non-recursive native watcher, observes one change, reports error and close, and records exact Node identity plus resource counts. Failure emits a durable typed CAPABILITY_BLOCKED receipt and performs no source judgment; a later successful probe cannot erase the earlier failure. A one-property forced-watch-failure control proves attribution, and a passing gate releases watcher-dependent validation without weakening its native anchor.

items.title: Resolve worktree base identity in the target project before thread creation
items.acceptance: Before a thread record is created, BB resolves the requested branch/commit in the exact target project's repository and records repository identity plus resolved object ID. A source object that exists only in another checkout yields one typed pre-creation routing error with the exact source and target repository identities and suggests an existing compatible environment or explicit transfer; no provider start or orphan thread occurs. Branch and raw-SHA controls each pass in the owning repository and fail deterministically in a non-owning repository.

items.title: Make builtin-plugin package validation hermetic and bounded
evidenceRefs: thr_rmujfj4jtd DESIGN_BLOCKED: clean-base reload/disposal lacks bounded termination or acknowledged cancellation
items.acceptance: Without claiming production plugin-runtime quiescence, watcher-heavy validation runs in an owned child process with a parent-side bound and actual child-close acknowledgement; deterministic test doubles account for every created/closed watcher; one isolated native-watch control preserves real delivery/error coverage; timeout or missing close is a typed test failure, never a pass; and the complete server inventory runs with isolated npm state, no EMFILE/unhandled errors, gaps, or duplicate execution.

items.title: Design bounded production plugin reload and teardown isolation
items.acceptance: Enumerate the complete synchronous plugin API, artifact-reader/writer, runtime identity, DB/resource, CLI, server, daemon, and SDK migration required to move all load-bearing reload/factory/dispose work behind a parent-owned killable process boundary, or explicitly ratify a conditional degraded-stop contract. The selected design must preserve immutable generation publication, require actual child close for termination credit, retain uncertain external effects, and pass independent architecture review before source work.

items.title: Eliminate hand-authored artifact hashes from cross-thread handoffs
items.acceptance: A handoff command derives attachment path, object kind, and digest from one observed artifact receipt; the durable inbox carries that binding without manual transcription; the receiver independently rehashes before admission; wrong-path, stale-hash, and byte-changed controls fail without repinning or model work.

items.title: Move authority identity adaptation into harness-owned derivation
items.acceptance: The harness derives subject and target-manifest identities once, exposes them as typed outputs, rejects mismatches during compile, and prevents issuers from hand-serializing objects that gates recompute.

items.title: Standardize issuer-owned compile/preflight control labs
items.acceptance: Before authority freeze, one generated lab executes every passing baseline, one-property mutant, intended-rule attribution, exact restoration, output-topology control, and consumer command under the installed gates.

items.title: Reconcile plugin filesystem access with the no-node:fs boundary
evidenceRefs: exact clean base and WG-INT-007 candidate emit the same four node:fs restriction diagnostics
items.acceptance: Inventory every direct plugin-runtime filesystem operation, its root, caller, and required capability; migrate workspace access to the host-daemon boundary or explicitly authorize only proven server-local state under a reviewed threat model; the changed-scope oxlint gate then passes without a blanket suppression, while unrelated no-node:fs enforcement remains intact.

items.title: Complete the legitimate contract-drift successor path outside U2
evidenceRefs: installed U2 emits PROPOSED_AMENDMENT but not authorization
items.acceptance: U2 only classifies and proposes; a manager-owned explicit decision creates a distinct +1 objective/campaign revision with exact predecessor joins, selective invalidation, predecessor retirement, and no historical mutation.

items.title: Make validation-receipt broker use deterministic for eligible checks
items.acceptance: Every eligible source/static validation enters through the broker by construction; over at least 50 eligible validations broker use exceeds 80%, false hits remain zero, and hits report avoided wall time and cost.

items.title: Promote deterministic campaign auto-advance from shadow
items.acceptance: A no-product cohort proves declared deterministic transitions advance without model calls, ambiguous/error/blocked outcomes wake the manager, no false transitions occur, and rollback to shadow is exact.

items.title: Run matched successful-campaign cohort for time, tokens, cycles, and cost
items.acceptance: Comparable successful tasks run with and without the integrated harness; report prework calls/tokens/wall time, total tokens/cost, repair cycles, idle time, cache hit rate, and confidence intervals with no product-quality regression.

items.title: Publish a shared immutable artifact and decision index across threads
evidenceRefs: repeated cross-thread hash and authority reconstruction
items.acceptance: Threads resolve immutable inputs, decisions, terminal receipts, and supersession from a content-addressed campaign index with acknowledged delivery; cached facts never substitute for live/provider/test evidence.
